decisions.name: Fuyang
decisions.reason: WUP11726 is the Fuyang/富阳 area of Hangzhou, Zhejiang; the previously researched WUP10440 is Fuyang/阜阳, Anhui. Official Hangzhou material locates 富阳 at 29°44′–30°11′ N and 119°25′–120°09′ E, containing the candidate point. The two WUP points are about 503 km apart and have distinct source City_Codes. The Anhui city packet therefore is not an attempt on WUP11726. Its WUP name, point, rank, and 415492-person population remain unchanged; local parcel custody and public geometry are unverified.

evidence.observation: Official WUP 2025 roster records candidate code 11726, rank 1354, point 30.0487792622136,119.946255782194 and Pop 415.492 thousand; derived from the locally retained official bulk CSV.
Prior Anhui Fuyang investigation is specifically WUP10440 at 32.893547722873,115.823161424229, with no verified public parcel geometry.

Official Hangzhou environmental publication states 富阳区 is in Zhejiang and gives its latitude and longitude range. Public search index exposed this passage; direct PDF fetch was too large for the web reader.

decisions.name: Belkuchi
decisions.reason: The two records have distinct WUP City_Codes and population-weighted points about 14.88 km apart. The previously reviewed WUP5431 packet scoped its local custody finding to the Belkuchi Upazila land office. The official Belkuchi Upazila page gives 24°13′–24°22′ N and 89°37′–89°47′ E; WUP5431 is inside this envelope, whereas WUP5323 at 24.1558909100762,89.6088819200885 is south and slightly west of it. The earlier local-office review therefore does not establish an attempt at the candidate point. Keep WUP5323 pending for point-scoped research; its precise administrative attribution and parcel coverage remain unresolved, and its source name, point, rank, and 410861-person population remain unchanged.

evidence.observation: Official WUP 2025 roster records candidate code 5323, rank 1372, point 24.1558909100762,89.6088819200885 and Pop 410.861 thousand; derived from the locally retained official bulk CSV.
Prior WUP5431 investigation is tied to Belkuchi Upazila land office at 24.2698075545558,89.6857818853253; it did not verify public parcel geometry.
Direct official Belkuchi Upazila page returned HTTP 200 and states the 24°13′–24°22′ N, 89°37′–89°47′ E coordinate range.
Official adjacent Shahjadpur Upazila page lists Belkuchi to its north, supporting a separate area south of Belkuchi; exact candidate jurisdiction is not asserted.
Original first-party HTML response hash and the relevant geographic sentence were retained after direct fetch.

scope: Two identity holds resolved as different prior-attempt scopes. The immutable WUP roster is preserved; both codes enter the pending investigation queue. No parcel source or runtime admission is implied.
